profileSeparates: Manila Bay coastline major catch groups
limits: The PDF does not provide a species-by-river/dam checklist in the reviewed sections.
Manila Bay coastline catch groups cannot be assigned to specific rivers or waterbodies.
Aquaculture species are not evidence of wild occurrence in each named freshwater body.
FishR and production figures are historical aggregates, not current abundance or catchability.
No item-specific reuse license or public redistribution permission was found in the PDF.
